data.body: Investigation: This bug was already fixed in commit 928e86ddfd ('fix(1c89-68ee): clear leaked ERR traps before exit in pre-bash.sh block paths'). The current code at line 147 of pre-bash.sh has the fix: trap - ERR EXIT 2>/dev/null || true. The error only occurred in plugin v1.13.0 which predates this fix.
